title: Authorizing balance reads and transfers between bank accounts
name: Account transfer routes

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how these routes decide whether the caller may act on an account? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A logged-in customer requests the balance of an account ID that belongs to another customer. What response do they get?
choices: 404 account_not_found, the same as for an ID that does not exist
200 with the balance, because the caller is authenticated

questions.prompt: A client times out and resends the exact same transfer request with the same idempotencyKey. Assuming TransferService honours the key, what happens?
choices: The transfer runs again and the source is debited twice
The second request is rejected with 409
The original result is returned with status 200 and no second debit
The second request returns 201 with a new transferId

questions.prompt: Which of these does the transfer route check before calling TransferService.execute?
choices: That the source has enough balance to cover amountMinor
That the source account is not frozen and that both accounts use the same currency
That the destination account is not frozen
That amountMinor is under a daily transfer limit
